facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: A$200K cash investment + A$500K worth of deals/perks + clinical/commercial access
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Early-stage technology startup aligned to MS/neuro care themes; global applicants accepted.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 16-week program with global network and Perth ecosystem; in-person and online events.
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见公开统一签证支持；若需赴美/赴欧线下参加，必须自行确认合法入境与停留资格。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Name: Olivia Brooks / Nick le Fevre / Charlotta Kemp
facts_raw.Public Contact Role: Head of Investments / Strategic Partnerships / Program Lead
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: AI, robotics, wearables, digital health and care-tech addressing MS, Parkinson's, stroke, Huntington's, MND, ABI or adjacent neurological care.
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: General wellness with no neurological-care pathway; products unable to benefit from clinical/patient validation.
